description: This header file defines exported API function prototypes for the Slap Loam Server component within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) in the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It declares functions for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the Loam Server object.

methods.name: SlapCreateLoamServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Loam Server object, given container and owner contexts.

methods.name: SlapLsoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Slap Loam Server object.

methods.name: SlapLsoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified Loam Server object.

methods.name: SlapLsoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the Loam Server context.
